name: NerdFlow
description: NerdFlow builds business software and AI tools through NerdFlow ONE and ReceptAI. Its products support hospitality and restaurant operations; the company also describes HostBNB as a version delivered under another brand.

name: Veyn.ai
description: Veyn builds AI tools that score calls, transcribe conversations in multiple languages and connect with customer-management software. Email Copilot and Chat Agent help teams handle customer communication.

name: AXI Technologies
description: AXI Technologies develops security and AI products, including PakOS, Khudi Chat and security-monitoring tools. Its published applications also include an admissions chatbot and a tool for screening job applications.

name: RedMarker Systems
description: RedMarker builds assessment software for schools, institutions and examination bodies. Its rTestGen, rMarker and rCBT products support test creation, marking and computer-based exams, with published examples of work for education organizations.

name: Sahl
description: Sahl helps teams manage compliance policies, requirements and supporting records in one system. Its tools assess gaps, prepare policies and support audit preparation, with a focus on Arabic-speaking users and regional requirements.

name: IFS — Imagineering Fast Solutions
description: IFS provides engineering services, aerospace technology and autonomous systems. NICAT records a contract to support a VR facility in Muscat, Oman, alongside capabilities in systems integration and technical project delivery.

name: RoboMAK
description: RoboMAK offers precision manufacturing, hardware prototypes and electronic-system development, including mechanical design, 3D printing and CNC machining. Its published examples include robotic handling and battery-management systems.

name: DynaSys Networks
description: DynaSys develops connected-device systems using its ALEF platform, network connections and satellite technology. Its published work includes a reported LoRaWAN network launch with Jazz in Lahore and partnerships involving satellite infrastructure.

name: Global Defense Insight
description: Global Defense Insight provides media and communications services for specialist industries. Its work includes sponsored content, digital campaigns, publication design and reporting for international industry events.

name: The Brave Next
description: The Brave Next uses AI to check safety equipment, flag intrusions and spot unusual activity in industrial settings. Its wider platform covers inventory, assets and data analysis, with cloud and on-site options described in NICAT records.

name: RLABS
description: RLABS builds simulations and interactive learning tools for specific subjects and skills. Its work uses software and visual models to represent complex activities in digital training environments.

name: NEXA Eye
description: NEXA Eye develops AI systems that analyze images for industrial safety, security and quality checks. Its platform is described as designed for straightforward setup in existing operations.

name: AIDE AI
description: AIDE AI supports assignment creation, assessment and AI-assisted grading, including handwritten work. Its dashboards show topic-level performance to help teachers, students and parents understand learning progress.

name: AirNex
description: AirNex analyzes drone and satellite images for agriculture, industrial inspection and infrastructure. It combines mapping and data analysis to help teams answer questions about the areas or assets they monitor.

name: 2Insects
description: 2Insects works on handling organic waste and recovering useful materials from it. Its focus connects waste management with the needs of farming and agriculture.

name: Aangan
description: Aangan develops menstrual-health and wellness software for South Asian women. Its stated features include cycle tracking, PCOS tracking, regional-language support and access to online health consultations.

name: Ace Aeronautics
description: Ace Aeronautics develops a caged-drone concept designed to withstand collisions. Its design combines an internal frame, a movement-isolating gimbal and an outer protective cage.

name: ADLIFE
description: ADLIFE works on mobility solutions and road-safety concepts in Pakistan. It brings these two areas together in its development work.

name: AeroThrust System PVT.LTD
description: AeroThrust develops drone systems for agriculture, infrastructure, delivery and disaster response. Its reported capabilities combine hardware, onboard electronics, software and AI for specific aerial tasks.

name: Aflaq
description: Aflaq is developing a media platform for education and entertainment about space and aerospace. It brings related content together for people interested in learning about these subjects.

name: AIBL
description: AIBL is developing a bionic leg for people with above-knee amputations. Its design work focuses on walking movement and how the user controls the prosthetic limb.

name: Al Ahsan Engineering Solution
description: Al Ahsan Engineering Solution reverse engineers parts using 3D scanning and material analysis. It works with metals, polymers, composites and thin films to understand a component's shape, materials and manufacturing needs.

name: Ampflick
description: Ampflick combines component sourcing, PCB design and custom software and AI development. It also describes a teaching platform that connects students with technical mentors.

name: APRO
description: APRO develops aerospace research and education concepts, including experimental platforms and student workshops. Its work combines hands-on technical learning with research and testing activities.

name: Aquashield
description: Aquashield develops connected water systems. SWMS automates dispensing, while AQUAS monitors water quality and can trigger purification; both connect to a cloud dashboard for usage reports and operating information.

name: Arm Rehab Technologies
description: Arm Rehab Technologies develops robotic hand prosthetics using 3D printing and laser cutting. Its designs use EMG muscle signals for control and modular parts that support repairs.

name: AURA-AI
description: AURA-AI combines satellite, aerial and environmental data in mapping software. It uses AI and predictive models to support work in disaster management, aviation and urban planning.

name: AZ Navteq (SMC-Pvt) Ltd
description: AZ Navteq provides mapping and location-data consulting using drones, satellites, photogrammetry, LiDAR and AI. It combines these methods to capture and understand terrain and physical environments.

name: Bakar Sol
description: Bakar Sol develops training simulations that combine 3D environments with physical equipment. Its systems also provide feedback and performance data to support the training process.

name: Betelwise
description: Betelwise develops THOTH, an AI engine for autonomous systems operating in complex, changing environments. Logistics is one of the intended uses named by the company.

name: CamPaint
description: CamPaint works on surface materials and smart climate windows. Its development focuses on how these materials can affect indoor comfort and a building's environmental performance.

name: Camsense
description: Camsense develops AI video-analysis software for retail stores and marts. It connects to existing CCTV systems and flags suspected theft so staff can review the footage and decide how to respond.

name: Carbotech
description: Carbotech manufactures nanomaterials for use in other materials, including epoxy. It works on how these additions combine with the surrounding material for a specific application.

name: CMOontheGo
description: CMOontheGo offers virtual marketing-leadership support for founders with small teams. Its focus is helping founders plan, organize and carry out marketing without a large internal department.

name: CoBlack Corp
description: CoBlack Corp develops a job-application platform using its Kosmos AI engine. It uses a person's profile to find openings, match requirements, tailor resumes and support submissions through employer application systems.

name: Cogent RFMW Ltd
description: Cogent RFMW designs radio-frequency and microwave products for communications and other technical uses. Its work focuses on the engineering of systems that use electromagnetic signals.

name: Dafinitiq AI
description: Dafinitiq AI develops Hilda for incoming and outgoing business calls. Its described uses include reception, customer support, lead checks and surveys, using speech recognition and conversation analysis.

name: Digi Deaf
description: Digi Deaf supports sign-language learning and employment opportunities for deaf people. Its work combines communication skills, accessible education and job placement for learners and job seekers.

name: EBioSensors4Life
description: EBioSensors4Life designs electronic systems that combine motion sensing, visual information and biosensing. Its work uses these inputs to create responsive digital and physical experiences.

name: Ecofilament
description: Ecofilament develops 3D-printing filament from waste PET bottles. It uses strips of the recovered plastic as the starting material for producing filament used in 3D printing.

name: Eligent Intelligence (EI)
description: Eligent Intelligence develops AI software for the legal industry. Its focus is helping legal professionals organize and carry out work within a practice or team.

name: Explorer Bees PVT LTD
description: Explorer Bees works on social media and improvements to business processes. It combines digital communication with changes to how a business organizes and carries out its work.

name: EZ Qanoon
description: EZ Qanoon connects clients with lawyers and law firms in Pakistan. Its platform includes legal research, case management and escrow-payment processes, with access for overseas Pakistanis.

name: Flight Deck Aviation
description: Flight Deck Aviation combines modular hardware, custom software and cloud-based flight training. Its tools support air-traffic-control, multiplayer and remote-learning scenarios for aviation schools, enthusiasts and professionals.

name: Flynautix
description: Flynautix develops flight-control technology and aircraft electronics for unmanned platforms. Its recorded work includes a flight-control prototype, flight testing, onboard electronics and onboard software.

name: ForresOn
description: ForresOn monitors forests with a focus on deforestation and sustainable management. Its work gathers information about forest conditions and changes to support forest-management decisions.

name: Four Engineers
description: Four Engineers develops electronic systems for industry and agriculture, including embedded controls, smart irrigation, power electronics and connected devices. The company reports deploying its AgriSoil irrigation controller in the Cholistan Desert.

name: Gallant Solutions
description: Gallant Solutions develops training simulators with physical controls and virtual environments. Its wider work includes 3D modeling, virtual tours, robotics and game development for representing equipment and procedures digitally.

name: GeMorph
description: GeMorph is researching ways to build 3D facial models from DNA. Its forensic work explores uses in investigations, including cases where an existing DNA database has no match.

name: Geospyre Consultants
description: Geospyre uses drone and satellite images to monitor crops for poor health, pests, water stress and weak growth. It presents the findings as maps and alerts for farmers and agricultural specialists.

name: GrainHero
description: GrainHero develops a connected platform for grain storage. It monitors storage conditions, estimates spoilage risk and controls ventilation for farmers, warehouse operators and food-storage organizations.

name: Grow Up
description: Grow Up develops a software-based gaming-controller concept. Its work explores how physical movement can be used to interact with games and control the playing experience.

name: Homstels
description: Homstels connects students and young workers with hostels and rental accommodation. Its platform brings housing options together for people finding somewhere to live near work or study.

name: INLIGHTS
description: INLIGHTS develops a mobile robot with an arm for welding. Its concept combines movement, controlled positioning and robotic welding for repeatable work in industrial settings.

name: International Vacuum Center
description: International Vacuum Center supplies vacuum equipment, systems and plants, from rough vacuum to ultra-high vacuum. Its range includes pumps, gauges, valves and related accessories.

name: iSeeWaves
description: iSeeWaves develops security software for tracking software components and supply-chain risks. It uses graph analysis to help regulated fintech firms and software exporters organize dependencies, compliance records and ongoing security checks.

name: Jaaidad.com
description: Jaaidad.com operates a property marketplace with listings, buyer requests and property exchanges. It also includes directories where users can find architects and interior designers.

name: Kalam4Solutions Pvt. Ltd.
description: Kalam4Solutions applies drones to agriculture, using aerial observations to support farming decisions. Its work helps farmers gather information about their crops and use it in agricultural planning.

name: LeObran Avionics CyberSecurity
description: LeObran focuses on cybersecurity for airports, aircraft and ground stations. Its work addresses the security needs of connected technology and infrastructure used in aviation operations.

name: Mach Alpha
description: Mach Alpha develops AI-enabled drones and engineering systems for uses including industrial work and emergency response. The company reports completing UAV and engineering projects across drone and AI technologies.

name: Madnoob
description: Madnoob works on combining blockchain technology with gaming. Its focus is the design and development of game applications that bring these two software areas together.

name: Metaverse Deviser
description: Metaverse Deviser creates stories using 3D animation and digital art. Its work also explores NFTs as a way to present and distribute artistic work.

name: Mozters
description: Mozters focuses on flexible, weatherproof designs for materials and branding applications. Its work considers both how a design looks and how its materials respond to weather.

name: MR3D
description: MR3D creates VR simulations, gaming assets and 3D models for medical education, industrial training, research and entertainment. It builds digital representations of objects, environments and procedures.

name: NaqshaGPT
description: NaqshaGPT uses generative AI to help users request maps for specific regions and dates. It retrieves GIS and remote-sensing data and displays the results in one process.

name: NEO REALMS
description: NEO REALMS creates projection-mapping and holographic experiences for outdoor and other public advertising spaces. Its work combines visual content with physical locations for immersive campaigns.

name: NEXERIN / TITANNO
description: NEXERIN, also named TITANNO, develops AI-driven autonomous systems and rescue technology. Its work combines research and robotic engineering to adapt unmanned systems to different operating needs.

name: Novatech Engineering Enterprises
description: Novatech works on metal 3D printing, reverse engineering and connected manufacturing technology. Its focus is developing locally produced components and industrial processes for demanding applications.

name: NSIT
description: NSIT develops software, embedded electronics, connected devices and hardware. Its wider record includes drones and aircraft electronics, while its general business capabilities cover full-stack software and industrial-system integration.

name: Omnisolve AI
description: Omnisolve AI develops automation for real estate, agriculture and mobility. Its systems connect manual tasks through AI-supported software, with Kisan Pukara named as an agricultural application.

name: OOTIEN PRIVATE LIMITED
description: OOTIEN develops food products for people managing allergies. Its online and mobile tools support ordering, delivery tracking and food-allergy information alongside the physical products.

name: Orchad Tech
description: Orchad Tech applies drones to farming, including crop detection, ripeness assessment and disease identification. Its work uses aerial observation to help assess conditions across a farm.

name: PakistanSupercomputingCenter
description: PakistanSupercomputingCenter develops high-performance computing for data analysis, AI, modeling and simulation. Its locally developed technology focuses on tasks that need substantial computing power and handle large volumes of data.

name: power sodium
description: power sodium researches battery technologies beyond lithium for storing renewable energy. Its development goals include sustainability, safety and affordability in alternative energy-storage systems.

name: QuantumChain
description: QuantumChain develops post-quantum security tools for blockchains and other systems. Its scope includes digital signatures, identity and data protection, with SDK or API connections and an on-site deployment option.

name: RD: Rescue Drone
description: RD: Rescue Drone is developing a remotely controlled rescue-drone concept with a hoist. The project explores how an unmanned aircraft and lifting system could support disaster response.

name: Rein N Raus
description: Rein N Raus develops rental-management tools for collecting rent, paying landlords and supporting tenant financing. It combines payment administration with risk-management processes to address different payment schedules.

name: RobotIQs Pvt Ltd
description: RobotIQs develops robotics for healthcare, ground vehicles and agriculture. Its stated products include upper-limb prosthetics controlled by muscle signals and modular mobile robots for inspection, research and hazardous environments.

name: SAFAR (South Asian Facility for Analog Research)
sourceName: SAFAR (South Asian Facility for Analog Research)
description: SAFAR is developing a proposed research station using pressurized habitats. Its goals include planetary-science research, astronaut training and space-technology testing, with potential locations in Pakistan under consideration.

name: SEMS
description: SEMS develops connected electricity meters with a mobile app. The system lets users view consumption information and manage electricity use through a digital interface.

name: SenseGuard
description: SenseGuard develops systems to detect gas leaks and children near household fire hazards. Its concept combines sensors, automatic gas shutoff and phone notifications.

name: Skyrone Technologies
description: Skyrone Technologies designs, fabricates and develops unmanned aircraft. Its stated focus includes autonomous navigation and precision aerial tasks, combining the aircraft with its operating systems.

name: Space Reserch Center (SRC) / AERISE
description: Space Reserch Center, also named AERISE, proposes a custom drone platform for educational CANSAT experiments. The concept supports space-technology research, teaching and hands-on aerospace activities.

name: Spinal Power SMC Pvt Ltd
description: Spinal Power works on battery technology in Pakistan. Its focus is battery development and research into ways to store energy.

name: Stelalliance
description: Stelalliance develops Stellar Scholar, combining STEM lessons, aerospace design challenges and learning simulations. Its education concept uses interactive activities to help students explore science and engineering.

name: Synkron Dynamics
description: Synkron Dynamics works on control systems, robotics and intelligent test equipment. Its engineering combines hardware with the technology needed to direct and test its operation.

name: Tech Valley
description: Tech Valley provides software and hardware solutions for public- and private-sector organizations. Its work covers both digital applications and the physical systems used in a technology project.

name: TechToo Digital(AgriShield)
description: TechToo Digital develops AgriShield, a cloud-based crop-protection concept using computer vision. It identifies bird species and changes deterrence patterns to address birds becoming used to a fixed response.

name: Texocor
description: Texocor develops a platform for selling and managing advertising space. Owners can list spaces and schedule content; advertisers can find locations, book placements and use pricing and performance information to organize campaigns.

name: THE BOOSTERS
description: THE BOOSTERS develops electric blimps for aerial advertising. Its concept uses a remotely controlled platform to display messages and draw attention to a campaign.

name: Thin Film Coating for Aerospace Applications (Aircraft engine parts coatings)
sourceName: Thin Film Coating for Aerospace Applications (Aircraft engine parts coatings)
description: This venture develops thin-film coatings for aerospace parts. Its work focuses on lightweight surface protection and research into wear and friction in demanding conditions.

name: Visuar solutions
description: Visuar Solutions builds augmented-reality experiences and interactive software using AR, web and Unity development. Its work combines computer vision and AI with visual ways to understand and explore information.

name: Waste Hero
description: Waste Hero is a social-benefit venture applying game-like activities to waste management. Its concept focuses on engaging people and encouraging participation in waste-related activities.

name: WaterGenix
description: WaterGenix develops water-harvesting technology using nanomaterial capsules that capture and release moisture from air. Its concept targets off-grid use in communities facing water shortages.

name: WAYFI (VoyaGO)
description: WAYFI, also named VoyaGO, develops an indoor-navigation app using real-time information. It helps users understand their location and find their way through indoor spaces.

name: Wheat Factory Pvt Ltd
description: Wheat Factory supports small-scale farmers with agricultural expertise, resources and technology. Its stated aim is to strengthen crop production and farming capability around specific agricultural needs.

name: XI-Pulse
description: XI-Pulse develops AI-supported VR and AR training for healthcare, aviation, education and industry. Its simulations combine practice scenarios, performance data and real-time feedback to support learning.

name: Zilly AI
description: Zilly AI brings writing, coding, design, analysis and voice tasks into one workspace. It connects tasks across tools, remembers brand preferences and offers access to multiple AI models.

name: Zumar
description: Zumar connects admissions, HR, scheduling and academic records in one education-management platform. It includes student and parent portals alongside teacher tools for gradebooks and course management.
